# Aurora Motion Player — Test Fixtures

This directory contains small sample media files used by integration tests.

## Contents

| File | Size | Description |
|------|------|-------------|
| `sample_720p.mp4` | ~2MB | H.264 720p 30fps, 5 seconds, with AAC audio |
| `sample_1080p.mp4` | ~5MB | H.264 1080p 24fps, 5 seconds, stereo AAC |
| `sample_av1.webm` | ~1MB | AV1 480p 30fps, 3 seconds |
| `sample_subtitle.mkv` | ~1MB | H.264 720p with embedded SRT subtitle track |
| `sample.srt` | ~1KB | SRT subtitle file with 10 events |
| `sample.ass` | ~3KB | ASS subtitle file with styles and override tags |
| `sample.vtt` | ~1KB | WebVTT subtitle file with cue IDs and notes |

## Generating Fixtures

Run the provided script to download or generate all fixtures:

```bash
python3 models/download_models.py --fixtures-only
```

Or generate synthetic fixtures using FFmpeg (no download required):

```bash
# sample_720p.mp4 — synthetic color bars, 5 seconds
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=5:size=1280x720:rate=30 \
       -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:duration=5 \
       -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 28 \
       -c:a aac -b:a 128k \
       tests/fixtures/sample_720p.mp4 -y

# sample_1080p.mp4 — synthetic color bars, 5 seconds
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=5:size=1920x1080:rate=24 \
       -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=880:duration=5 \
       -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -crf 28 \
       -c:a aac -b:a 128k \
       tests/fixtures/sample_1080p.mp4 -y

# sample_av1.webm — synthetic, 3 seconds
ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=duration=3:size=854x480:rate=30 \
       -c:v libaom-av1 -crf 50 -b:v 0 -cpu-used 8 \
       tests/fixtures/sample_av1.webm -y

# sample.srt — generated by download_models.py
```

## CI Usage

Integration tests skip gracefully when fixtures are absent:

```cpp
if (!fixtureExists("sample_720p.mp4")) {
    GTEST_SKIP() << "Fixture not found — run models/download_models.py first";
}
```

The CI workflow runs `models/download_models.py --fixtures-only` before
executing integration tests to ensure fixtures are available.
